title: Portable settings and dependable startup
summary: Move a complete Pivot setup between PCs, control application volume, and safely open settings written by newer builds.
highlights: Export and import versioned Pivot settings ZIPs containing profiles, mappings, shared wheels, and managed images, with validation, recovery backups, and rollback protection.
Bind wheel controls to per-application Windows volume actions alongside microphone controls.
Preserve unfamiliar future system actions as inactive data instead of crashing while opening the settings store.
Use the available workspace width consistently while keeping the desktop window within its focused maximum size.
